# Papered v0.2.0 — Insights, Graph Locator & Startup Reliability (Alpha)

> **⚠️ Alpha Notice**
> This is an early, experimental release. The API, CLI, data format, and database schema are subject to breaking changes without notice. Not recommended for production use.

This release makes first-run startup reliable end-to-end and adds two web UI features: AI-drafted paper insights for your notes, and library-wide paper search in the relatedness graph.

## Highlights

- **AI paper insights in notes** — A 🤔 button next to "Add note" on the paper detail page drafts a three-part take (💡 insight / 🔍 critique / 🌱 inspiration) into the note box via your configured `rag` model. The draft lands in the textarea; saving it as a note stays your call. New endpoint: `POST /api/v1/papers/{id}/insights`.
- **Find any paper in the graph** — The graph view gains a search box that matches the whole library, not just the rendered slice. In-view hits are pinned, centered, and pulsed; out-of-view hits reload the graph with a new `focus` parameter that pulls in the paper together with its strongest library-wide neighbors, so you see real relationships instead of an isolated dot. "Links/paper" now goes up to 20.

## Fixes

- **First-run daemon startup** — Fixed the "Timed out waiting for daemon to start" failure that hit fresh installs: the daemon no longer blocks on the embedding-model network probe before binding its port, so `papered ui` works on a brand-new, unconfigured setup.
- **Duplicate / stale daemon handling** — The daemon writes a PID file at startup and cleans up registration files on every exit path; a second instance exits immediately with an "already running" message, and stale registration left by `kill -9` is detected via liveness checks and self-heals instead of looping on turso "file is locked" errors.
- **Daemon log** — Daemon stdout/stderr from CLI-spawned instances now goes to `{data_dir}/logs/daemon.log`, so startup failures are diagnosable.
- **Upgrade safety** — Existing vector stores are no longer wiped when the stored embedding fingerprint is missing (legacy databases rebuild only when the model actually changed).
- **Windows** — Fixed `process_alive` in the daemon liveness check.

## Installation

**macOS / Linux:**
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WuChenh/Papered/main/install.sh | bash
```

**Windows (PowerShell):**
```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WuChenh/Papered/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

**From source (requires Rust toolchain):**
```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/WuChenh/Papered.git papered papered-daemon
```

Or download the pre-built binary for your platform from the assets below.
